cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've spotted the missing savings. Those budget lessons paid off. It's a banking complication; keep our anniversary reservation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's back Friday. You're getting good at questions, but remember where that one got us last time: separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let your teacher make this call. You still ask the most explosive question first. Please, I'd like us sharing a table when the money comes back.
